description: This is a PHP source file defining a Controller class 'ChannelController' within a web application framework. It manages various actions related to channel pages, including listing projects, handling FAQs, resources, creating and applying to projects, and displaying blog posts. The class integrates with models, views, and external libraries to facilitate channel-specific functionality for a crowdfunding or project-sharing platform.

classes.name: ChannelController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing channel-related pages and actions, including listing projects, handling FAQs, resources, creating/applying to projects, and displaying blog posts within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, setting database connection configurations and theme.

methods.name: setChannelContext
methods.description: Sets up context variables for a channel page, verifying access permissions and retrieving channel data, categories, sections, sponsors, and announcements.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Displays the main page of a channel, including featured projects and sections.

methods.name: listProjectsAction
methods.description: Lists projects within a channel based on type (e.g., available, promoted).

methods.name: faqAction
methods.description: Displays the FAQ list for a specific channel.

methods.name: faqSlugAction
methods.description: Displays detailed FAQ content, questions, and downloads for a specific FAQ slug.

methods.name: resourcesAction
methods.description: Displays resource categories and resources for a channel.

methods.name: createAction
methods.description: Handles project creation within a channel, verifying login and handling form submissions.

methods.name: applyAction
methods.description: Allows logged-in users to apply a project to a channel and fill out questionnaires.

methods.name: listChannelsAction
methods.description: Lists all active channels with a home image.

methods.name: getProjectFilters
methods.description: Constructs filters for project queries based on input parameters.

methods.name: discoverProjectsAction
methods.description: Provides a page to discover projects within a channel, filtered by various criteria.

methods.name: impactDiscoverAction
methods.description: Redirects to impact discovery maps or index views relative to a channel.

methods.name: ajaxSearchAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX project searches within a channel, returning a JSON list of projects.

methods.name: addValuesContext
methods.description: Adds impact data, footprints, and SDGs related context variables for channel views.

methods.name: blogPostAction
methods.description: Displays a blog post within a channel including related posts.
